## II. THE THESIS IN ONE SENTENCE

ELitas (ELTX) is a pre-revenue, single-asset clinical shell whose entire value is a dated, event-driven Phase 2 DFS readout (AMPLIFY-7P) in resected mutant-KRAS pancreatic cancer expected mid-2026; it is funded over that binary, a clean positive hazard ratio plausibly re-rates the thin ~19M-share float 3.5-5.5x onto a registrational/partnership path (squeeze mechanics can push it further and faster), and the negative branch — a thesis-to-zero failure into a lien-encumbered going-concern shell — is real but already priced at ~-80%/P=38%, leaving genuine, paid binary asymmetry (EV ~5:1, prob-weighted ~+134%).

## III. WHAT IT DOES

ELI-002 / ELI-002 7P is an off-the-shelf, lymph-node-targeted (AMP amphiphile-peptide) therapeutic vaccine against 7 KRAS mutations covering ~25% of solid tumors. The lead trial, AMPLIFY-7P, is a randomized Phase 2 (144 patients, 2:1, 24 US sites, enrollment complete) testing the vaccine versus observation in resected mKRAS PDAC, with disease-free survival (DFS) the primary endpoint. The design is clean — vaccine-vs-observation, FDA-aligned on dose/schedule/population/endpoint (EoP1 Type B alignment, Jan-2025). Supportive signals exist (AMPLIFY-201 16.3-month mRFS; 99% of 90 evaluable patients showed mKRAS T-cell responses, 145-fold mean, antigen spreading), but the value-binary is the randomized DFS readout, not the immunogenicity data.

## IV. WHY NOW

The name is LATE within its pre-catalyst window — the clock has already slipped four times (H1-2025 -> Q4-2025 -> 1H-2026 -> mid-2026) and the runway only just clears the readout. This is the inflection point, not an early entry: the binary either lands this summer or the runway pressure intensifies.

The direct, vastly-better-funded parallel is BioNTech/Roche autogene cevumeran (IMCODE-003, ~260-patient randomized Ph2 adjuvant PDAC vs mFOLFIRINOX±atezo, reading out 2026). Moderna/Merck intismeran (mRNA-4157; 5-year melanoma 49% RFS risk-reduction, Jan-2026; Ph3 melanoma 2026) is the theme validator and capital magnet but is NOT in PDAC. Substitute pressure also comes from mKRAS small molecules (daraxonrasib/RMC-6236, glecirasib, HRS-4642, TSN1611).
